plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for HW group STE / STE2 Ethernet thermometers (STE-MIB / STE2-MIB, enterprise PEN 21796). It reports uptime, temperature and relative humidity sensor readings, sensor alarm state, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: sensor_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Reading of each temperature sensor of the HW group STE / STE2 thermometer in degrees Celsius, from sensValue (STE-MIB 1.3.6.1.4.1.21796.4.1.3.1.5 / STE2-MIB 1.3.6.1.4.1.21796.4.9.3.1.5, value x10, divided by 10) on rows whose sensUnit (.7) is celsius, fahrenheit or kelvin; Fahrenheit and Kelvin readings are converted.

metrics.name: sensor_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Reading of each relative humidity sensor in percent, from sensValue (.5, divided by 10) on rows whose sensUnit is percent.

metrics.name: sensor_state
metrics.description: Alarm state of each sensor from sensState (STE-MIB 1.3.6.1.4.1.21796.4.1.3.1.3 / STE2-MIB 1.3.6.1.4.1.21796.4.9.3.1.3): normal maps to 1; outofrangelo, outofrangehi, alarmlo and alarmhi map to 2. Rows reporting invalid are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
